title: Duplicate Order Detector
summary: A shop's checkout sometimes submits the same basket twice. Fix the repeat finder, flag likely double submissions within a time window, then keep it fast on a sale-day order log.
followUps: Why did the code compile and run without any warning when the set never found a repeat?
What contract must equals and hashCode keep together, and what breaks in a HashSet when only one of them is right?
What is the cost of suspectedDuplicates for n orders, and how much memory does it need?
Orders arrive from two checkout servers whose clocks differ by a few seconds. What would you change?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
